packageRules.description: Majors land through scripts/headless/renovate-agent.ts, which reads this label.

The package files under scripts/gates/check-e2e-green.ts's e2e paths land through scripts/headless/renovate-agent.ts and land.ts, which runs the e2e suite; scripts/headless/renovate-agent.integration.test.ts holds this list to that predicate.
The package files under .claude/agent-hooks.jsonc's profile.review.risky land only with a human review verdict; scripts/headless/renovate-agent.integration.test.ts holds this list to that profile.

The two bengous/stack-watch includes of mise.toml move together, in one PR to the newest toolchain-YYYY.MM.DD tag, merged once every check is green. semver-coerced, the default versioning, reads such a tag as unstable and proposes nothing. The year is the major, so the yearly tag merges too. A tag is the owner's own release: it skips the release age.
